ruleset.name: Complexity Ruleset
ruleset.description: Cyclomatic complexity check used by the code-reviewer skill (.claude/skills/code-reviewer/SKILL.md, Cyclomatic Complexity section). Max allowed complexity is 15 per method — methodReportLevel is set to 16 because PMD reports a violation when complexity is greater than or equal to the configured level. classReportLevel (total complexity across a class's methods) is left effectively disabled since this check is scoped to individual methods only.
